name: Notion Connector
description: Read and operate on Notion workspaces: search, browse pages and their actual block content, query databases, create and update pages, comment, and manage database records across multiple workspaces.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List the connected Notion workspaces and whether each token still works.

refresh.description: Re-read workspace details from Notion instead of the cache
refresh.title: Refresh

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search pages and databases across a Notion workspace by title text.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme HQ'. Omit when only one Notion workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

query.description: Text to search for in page and database titles. Empty returns everything shared with the integration.
query.title: Query

kind.description: Limit results: 'page', 'database', or empty for both
kind.title: Kind

return_schema.description: A page or database visible to the integration.
return_schema.title: NotionObject

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read a Notion page: its properties and its actual block content.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme HQ'. Omit when only one Notion workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

page.description: Page title or Notion page id/URL id, e.g. 'Q3 Roadmap'
page.title: Page

include_content.description: Include the page's actual block content, not just properties
include_content.title: Include Content

max_blocks.description: Maximum blocks to read from the page body
max_blocks.title: Max Blocks

return_schema.description: A page with its properties and actual block content.
return_schema.title: PageContent

tools.name: browse
tools.description: Browse the workspace structure: top-level objects, or the children of a page.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme HQ'. Omit when only one Notion workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

parent.description: Page or database to list children of. Empty lists the top-level objects shared with the integration.
parent.title: Parent

return_schema.description: A page or database visible to the integration.
return_schema.title: NotionObject

tools.name: list_databases
tools.description: List the Notion databases the integration can reach.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme HQ'. Omit when only one Notion workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

return_schema.description: A page or database visible to the integration.
return_schema.title: NotionObject

tools.name: query_database
tools.description: Read the rows of a Notion database, with their property values.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme HQ'. Omit when only one Notion workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

sort_by.description: Property name to sort by, e.g. 'Due date'
sort_by.title: Sort By

return_schema.description: One row of a Notion database.
return_schema.title: DatabaseRow

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List the people and bots in a connected Notion workspace.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme HQ'. Omit when only one Notion workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

return_schema.description: A person or bot in the workspace.
return_schema.title: UserRecord

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: Read the comments on a Notion page.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme HQ'. Omit when only one Notion workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

page.description: Page title or id whose comments to read
page.title: Page

tools.name: check_access
tools.description: Report what this integration can currently reach in Notion, and explain why anything missing is not visible.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme HQ'. Omit when only one Notion workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

return_schema.description: What the integration can and cannot reach, and why.
return_schema.title: AccessReport

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a Notion page, either inside another page or as a row in a database.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme HQ'. Omit when only one Notion workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

parent.description: Parent page or database title/id. Empty places the page at the top level the integration can reach.
parent.title: Parent

content.description: Page body as plain text or simple markdown (# heading, - bullet, 1. numbered, > quote)
content.title: Content

properties.description: Database properties when creating a row, e.g. {'Status': 'In progress', 'Priority': 'High'}
properties.title: Properties

tools.name: update_page_content
tools.description: Add content to an existing Notion page.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme HQ'. Omit when only one Notion workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

page.description: Page title or id to add content to
page.title: Page

content.description: Text to add, as plain text or simple markdown
content.title: Content

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Update a Notion page's title or its database property values.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme HQ'. Omit when only one Notion workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

page.description: Page or database row title/id to update
page.title: Page

title.description: New title (omit to keep the current one)
title.title: Title

tools.name: move_page
tools.description: Move a Notion page under a different parent page or database.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme HQ'. Omit when only one Notion workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

page.description: Page title or id to move
page.title: Page

tools.name: trash_page
tools.description: Move a Notion page to the trash, or restore it back out.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme HQ'. Omit when only one Notion workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

page.description: Page title or id to move to Notion's trash
page.title: Page

restore.description: Set true to restore a page out of the trash instead
restore.title: Restore

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a Notion page.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme HQ'. Omit when only one Notion workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

page.description: Page title or id to comment on
page.title: Page

tools.name: create_database
tools.description: Create a Notion database inside a page, with the columns you name.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme HQ'. Omit when only one Notion workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

parent.description: Parent page title or id the database will live in
parent.title: Parent

properties.description: Column name -> type, e.g. {'Status': 'select', 'Due': 'date', 'Done': 'checkbox'}. A Name title column is always created.
properties.title: Properties

secrets.name: notion_tokens
secrets.description: Notion integration token(s) -- one per line, one line per workspace. Create at notion.so/my-integrations, then share the pages or databases the integration should reach.
